psych-dev-01-c3.text: Renée Baillargeon (1987). Object permanence in 3 1/2- and 4 1/2-month-old infants. Developmental Psychology, 23(5), 655-664.
psych-dev-01-c3.quote: However, the results of the experiments reported here indicate that infants as young as 3 1/2 months of age already realize that objects continue to exist when occluded.
psych-dev-01-c3.claim: it suggests object permanence is present far earlier than Piaget claimed.
